quickExit.label: Quick exit
quickExit.hint: Leaves this site immediately and clears this page. Shortcut: Shift + Esc.

home.title: You can raise a concern safely here
home.intro: Report harassment, discrimination, misconduct, fraud or safety issues. You choose whether to stay anonymous, and you choose who can read your report.

options.title: Know my options
options.desc: What counts, what happens next, and how anonymity works.

journal.title: Keep a private record
journal.desc: Write things down privately, with dates. Report later only if you want to.

report.title: Report a concern
report.desc: A short, step-by-step form. No account needed.

check.title: Check my case
check.desc: Use your case ID and passphrase to see updates and messages.

home.privacy: No account, no name required. Your report is locked on your device before it is sent, so only the committee members it is meant for can open it.

footer.demo: Student project prototype. Do not submit real incidents.
